chunk_map.heading: Map the gaps, read your stack (H1/lede)
Phase 1: Diff the two runs, rank the gaps
Read the contrast, push back where it generalises
Cut one stale rule the diagnosis killed
Say go, unless the cut spreads past the one rule
Phase 2: Find the work you repeat across your stack
Scan your history for the work that recurs
Draw your top work-shapes as diagrams
List the checks the field runs, rank the ones that fit your gap
Route the dominant gap to its home

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 0 "Map the gaps, read your stack": line 13: "The stack-map you draw is what the closing move builds from." — "the closing move" is not named anywhere earlier in the file (chunk 0 is the first chunk) and is not resolved until chunk 9's differently-worded "the closing lecture" (line 140), nine chunks later. This is the rule's explicit "pointing forward" violation shape. Not arc-earned spine vocabulary: a repo grep for "closing move" turns up only one other hit, an internal backing-block annotation in will-company-memory-emerge.md — not a term earned in a prior AE101 module's student-facing body.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Drop the forward-pointing clause from the chunk-0 framing, or replace "the closing move" with language that doesn't presuppose an undefined term at first use (let the actual name land where it's first defined, in chunk 9).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
Live-demo beats survive a text read.
Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 6 "Scan your history for the work that recurs": line 81: "> **This scan runs long, and it is yours to steer.**" — a full 9-word sentence bolded, not a ≲5-word handle sub-span. The sibling callout at line 79 ("**Fast operator?**", 2 words) stays within budget; this one doesn't.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Trim the bold to a short handle (e.g. bold just "yours to steer") and leave the rest of the sentence unbolded.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
